validators.category: Functional / Technical / Mission Coverage / Repository Governance
validators.notes: Validator confirms required framework artifacts, Boxercraft evidence, report/deck source text, expected deferrals, and resolved repository-governance records after GitHub submission. It passed twice after the report-status correction, twice after the competitor benchmark report update, twice after the GEN-007 browse-node parity report update, and twice after the GEN-008 local school PTA brief. It now requires the GEN-008 evidence summary, report source, PDF artifact, and validation records.

validators.category: Project-Specific External / Usability / UI Standards Validation
validators.notes: Managed sandbox launch failed with Chrome SIGABRT/kill EPERM, but the same npm script passed when Chrome was allowed to launch outside the sandbox. The passing run produced 18 screenshots and findings for autocomplete, search recovery, recommendations, and public wholesale search.
Run after Playwright was added as a devDependency; npm reported 0 vulnerabilities in Generation 3 and Generation 4 gate checks.

LaTeX compilation remains useful because the client-facing report and deck are core outputs. Generation 4 compiles confirmed the normalization and browse-routing narrative renders into PDFs. Generation 6 report-status correction and competitor benchmark report update both regenerated the assessment PDF successfully. Generation 8 compiled the two-page local school PTA opportunity brief successfully.

Text extraction and representative rendered pages continue to provide useful PDF evidence. Generation 4 checks verified updated normalization, UCLA/Bruins, and browse-routing content. Generation 6 report-status correction verified the stale GitHub-blocked copy was removed and page 6 still rendered cleanly. The competitor benchmark report update verified the new comparison text and rendered the competitor/final pages cleanly. Generation 8 verified the local school PTA report text, two-page count, and rendered page layout.

Generated the 36-query Boxercraft normalization matrix across retail search, rendered autocomplete, public wholesale search, and visible browse paths. Produced 60 screenshots and five accepted findings/signals.

Generated the GEN-006 competitor benchmark across public Shopify catalog feeds, rendered search/autocomplete/browse samples, and explicit Concepts Sport/Fanatics limitation records. One interrupted exploratory run led to a tighter catalog-plus-rendered-sample strategy.

Generated all-node browse/search/autocomplete parity evidence across public Boxercraft collections. An early run exposed methodology cleanup needs for merchandising-node classification and broad handle queries; a later run exposed 429 rate-limit handling needs. The final rate-limit-aware run completed with 96 collections discovered, 93 non-empty nodes evaluated, and no warnings or node errors.

note: Effectiveness tracking started with Generation 1 Validation Gate. Generation 6 added the competitor pricing and discovery benchmark evaluator. Generation 7 added the all-node browse/search/autocomplete parity evaluator. Generation 8 added the local school PTA executive report validation checks.
